_doc: D-359: SUPPORT scales energy with ordinary fusions and withholds the advanced fusion until its 10-second minimum energy income reaches Support::AdvancedFusionEnergyIncome (4000). Stage widgets/support_progress.lua. Thirty game minutes on Supreme Isthmus. Afterwards read the finished= lines: ordinary fusions should appear, an advanced fusion only after an 'advanced fusion allowed' line, and INV-237 never.

expect.pattern: SUPPORT\]\[Eco\] advanced fusion withheld: energy income \d+ against gate 4000
